# Guidance on Choosing the Next Step in a Business Process

## Forward Progress
- Always prefer transitions that advance the case toward a terminal (completion) state. At each step, choose the transition that makes forward progress rather than one that loops back or revisits an earlier state.

## Avoid Revisiting States
- Never re-enter a state that has already been visited in the current case execution. If a candidate transition would lead back to a previously visited state, skip it and choose an alternative that moves forward.

## Overall Process Flow Direction
- Maintain awareness of the overall process flow direction: always select the transition that is closest to the end of the process given the current process variables and case facts, avoiding cycles or backward transitions.
